name: torq-summer
notes: Convertible variant of 3D Sets Model 19 Torq; reuses Torq's 1971 Plymouth Ditzler chips verbatim.
The 'Billboard' tape-stripe graphic (V6W white / V6X black) was a 1971-only 'Cuda option, over one body colour -- not a two-tone paint, so there's no combinations.json here.

Factory stripe colour was white or black only; no exact per-bodycolour chart survives as text, only scanned option-book images -- the body/stripe pairing here (True Blue body, white stripe) follows the documented general rule (dark body -> white tape), not a verified specific chart.

TODO: an interior/seat zone (channel 1) was tried and pulled back out -- the seat's pale colour against the white backdrop didn't segment cleanly (neither the chroma hint nor a quick SAM attempt gave a clean boundary without bleeding into the background), and the hand-traced polygon that stood in for it was rough. Revisit with a proper multi-point SAM pass (several positive points along the headrest and cushion, tight negatives on the background and windshield frame) before re-adding it.
